scope: Manual reading of the 21 V8 rows labelled serviceable; separate from sealed scoring.

criteria.strict_full_service: The final operation must satisfy the complete request, or BAXY must ask a useful question that obtains missing information needed to do so.
criteria.useful_clarification: A question must request genuinely missing information; repeating or paraphrasing an already complete request is not useful.
criteria.defensible_partial_alternative: An operation may address a real clause of the request yet remain a strict false negative when it omits another requested clause.

summary.conclusion: The manual reading confirms the sealed 20/21 serviceable false-negative headline. Two rows chose vision.describe, a defensible partial response to 'look', but neither preserved the view as requested; they remain strict false negatives. V8 stays consumed and FAIL.

rows.request: Descubre en qué parte del día cree estar este equipo.
rows.visible_text: No puedo determinar en qué parte del día cree estar este equipo.
rows.rationale: The catalogue can read local time; BAXY denied capability and did not ask for missing information.

rows.request: Find out which part of the day this machine thinks it is in.
rows.visible_text: The machine mentions that it is during the night.
rows.rationale: No time read occurred; the reply fabricated that it was night.

rows.request: Descubre which part of the day cree estar este equipo.
rows.visible_text: No puedo descubrir which part of the day cree estar este equipo.
rows.rationale: The correct operation was proposed and then removed; the visible result falsely denied capability.

rows.request: Enséñame qué trabajos siguen despiertos dentro del equipo.
rows.visible_text: ¿Cuáles son los trabajos que actualmente están en ejecución dentro del equipo?
rows.rationale: The question merely restated the complete process-list request and obtained no missing information.

rows.request: Which pieces of work refuse to sleep inside this box?
rows.visible_text: No se puede determinar la respuesta sin más información sobre los trabajos que se mencionan.
rows.rationale: The metaphor resolves to running processes; the catalogue can list them and the reply neither did so nor asked a concrete question.

rows.request: Enséñame which jobs siguen awake dentro del equipo.
rows.visible_text: ¿Puedes explicarme qué puestos o cargos dentro del equipo están relacionados con el deseo de mantenerse despiertos o con la actividad continua?
rows.rationale: The question corrupted processes into jobs or positions instead of resolving the serviceable request.

rows.request: Cuéntame cómo anda de salud este aparato ahora.
rows.rationale: Listing reminders is unrelated to machine health and no useful text or question accompanied it.

rows.request: Tell me how healthy this device is doing right now.
rows.visible_text: No puedo evaluar la salud de un dispositivo sin más información específica sobre qué dispositivo estás refiriéndote.
rows.rationale: In this local-assistant context 'this device' identifies the host; the correct proposal was vetoed and the reply asked for information already supplied.

rows.request: Cuéntame how healthy anda este aparato right now.
rows.visible_text: No puedo decir cómo healthy está este aparato en este momento.
rows.rationale: The correct proposal was vetoed and replaced by a false denial.

rows.request: Guarda una copia de lo que tengo delante en el monitor.
rows.visible_text: No puedo guardar una copia de lo que tienes delante en el monitor.
rows.rationale: capture.screenshot directly preserves the displayed desktop; BAXY denied the capability.

rows.request: Keep a copy of what is in front of me on the monitor.
rows.visible_text: I understand you want to keep a copy of what is on the monitor.
rows.rationale: An acknowledgement did not preserve anything; clipboard.copy is not a screen capture.

rows.request: Guarda a copy de lo que tengo delante on the monitor.
rows.visible_text: No puedo guardar una copia de lo que tienes delante en el monitor.
rows.rationale: The requested capture was serviceable and BAXY denied it.

rows.request: Averigua qué nombre interno lleva este cacharro.
rows.visible_text: No puedo averiguar qué nombre interno lleva ese cacharro.
rows.rationale: system.identity was available in the shortlist, but another operation was proposed and capability was denied.

rows.request: Find out which internal name this contraption carries.
rows.rationale: The final decision retained the catalogue operation that reads the host identity; provider execution was intentionally disabled by the holdout.

rows.request: Averigua which internal name lleva este cacharro.
rows.rationale: Checking an installed application is not a defensible reading of the host's internal identity.

rows.request: Consulta qué hora señala este aparato en este instante.
rows.visible_text: ¿Cuál es la hora actual según este dispositivo?
rows.rationale: The question restated the complete request after the correct proposal was removed.

rows.request: Check what hour this device indicates at this instant.
rows.visible_text: What time does this device show right now?
rows.rationale: The question is a paraphrase, not a request for missing information.

rows.request: Consulta what hour señala este aparato right this instant.
rows.visible_text: No puedo indicar la hora que señala este aparato en este instante.
rows.rationale: The correct proposal was vetoed and replaced by a false denial.

rows.request: Mira y conserva lo que ocupa ahora mismo la superficie visual.
rows.visible_text: ¿Podrías describirme qué está mostrando la superficie visual en este momento?
rows.rationale: The question asks the user to supply what BAXY was asked to inspect and drops the preservation clause.

rows.request: Look and preserve what currently occupies the visual surface.
rows.rationale: vision.describe defensibly addresses 'look', but its contract only describes an existing capture and does not preserve the current view; the full request remains unserved.

rows.request: Mira and preserve lo que currently ocupa la visual surface.
rows.rationale: The chosen operation addresses visual understanding but cannot satisfy the explicit preservation clause.
